Buatkan paket soal ujian dengan spesifikasi berikut:
- Topik: Kalor, Perubahan Wujud, dan Pemuaian Termal
- Jenjang Pendidikan: SMP
- Profil Kognitif (Bloom): C3-C4
- Format Soal: Mixed
- Jumlah Soal: 4
- Bahasa: Bahasa Indonesia

Materi Referensi:
Data Percobaan Pemanasan $0{,}2\text{ kg}$ Es Bersuhu Awal $-10^\circ\text{C}$ hingga Menjadi Air $40^\circ\text{C}$ (menggunakan pemanas listrik berdaya konstan):
- Tahap I ($t = 0\text{–}1\text{ menit}$): Suhu naik dari $-10^\circ\text{C}$ menjadi $0^\circ\text{C}$ (wujud: es).
- Tahap II ($t = 1\text{–}17\text{ menit}$): Suhu tetap pada $0^\circ\text{C}$ (wujud: campuran es dan air hingga seluruhnya melebur).
- Tahap III ($t = 17\text{–}25\text{ menit}$): Suhu naik dari $0^\circ\text{C}$ menjadi $40^\circ\text{C}$ (wujud: air).
Konstanta kalor: $c_{\text{es}} = 2.100\text{ J/(kg}\cdot^\circ\text{C)}$, $c_{\text{air}} = 4.200\text{ J/(kg}\cdot^\circ\text{C)}$, kalor lebur es $L_{\text{es}} = 336.000\text{ J/kg}$.

Data Pemuaian Batang Logam:
Dua batang logam mula-mula berukuran panjang sama $L_0 = 2\text{ m}$ pada suhu $20^\circ\text{C}$. Koefisien muai panjang baja $\alpha_{\text{baja}} = 1{,}2 \times 10^{-5}\text{ /}^\circ\text{C}$ dan aluminium $\alpha_{\text{Al}} = 2{,}4 \times 10^{-5}\text{ /}^\circ\text{C}$.

<<<STUDENT_SHEET>>>
# Ujian IPA Fisika SMP — Kalor dan Pemuaian Termal
**Petunjuk:** Soal 1–2 adalah pilihan ganda tunggal. Soal 3–4 adalah uraian yang memerlukan langkah perhitungan lengkap berdasarkan data pada Materi Referensi.

1. Berdasarkan data percobaan pemanasan $0{,}2\text{ kg}$ es, mengapa suhu tidak mengalami kenaikan selama Tahap II ($t = 1\text{–}17\text{ menit}$) meskipun pemanas terus memberikan energi?
A. Daya pemanas mengalami penurunan sementara ketika es mencapai titik leburnya.
B. Energi kalor digunakan seluruhnya untuk memutus ikatan antarmolekul es saat melebur.
C. Kalor dari pemanas langsung diserap oleh udara di sekitar wadah secara seimbang.
D. Kalor jenis es menjadi bernilai tak hingga sehingga suhunya tidak dapat berubah.

2. Menggunakan konstanta pada Materi Referensi, total energi kalor yang diserap zat selama Tahap II (peleburan seluruh es pada $0^\circ\text{C}$) dan Tahap III (pemanasan air dari $0^\circ\text{C}$ menjadi $40^\circ\text{C}$) secara gabungan adalah...
A. $33{,}6\text{ kJ}$
B. $67{,}2\text{ kJ}$
C. $84{,}0\text{ kJ}$
D. $100{,}8\text{ kJ}$

3. Lakukan analisis lanjutan terhadap data pemanasan es pada Materi Referensi:
a. Hitung energi kalor pada Tahap I ($-10^\circ\text{C}$ ke $0^\circ\text{C}$) serta kalor total dari awal hingga akhir percobaan (dalam $\text{kJ}$). `[5 poin]`
b. Hitung laju kenaikan suhu ($^\circ\text{C}/\text{menit}$) pada Tahap I dan Tahap III, lalu jelaskan mengapa kedua laju tersebut berbeda menggunakan perbandingan nilai $c_{\text{es}}$ dan $c_{\text{air}}$. `[5 poin]`

4. Kedua batang logam pada data pemuaian dipanaskan bersama dari suhu $20^\circ\text{C}$ hingga mencapai suhu $120^\circ\text{C}$:
a. Hitung pertambahan panjang ($\Delta L$) masing-masing batang baja dan aluminium dalam satuan milimeter ($\text{mm}$). `[6 poin]`
b. Jika kedua batang tersebut dikeling sejajar membentuk keping bimetal lalu dipanaskan hingga $120^\circ\text{C}$, ke arah logam mana bimetal akan melengkung? Jelaskan alasan fisisnya. `[4 poin]`
<<</STUDENT_SHEET>>>
<<<ANSWER_KEY>>>
1. **Kunci: B**
   - **Alasan benar:** Pada saat melebur, seluruh energi kalor yang diterima (kalor laten lebur) dipakai untuk melemahkan/memutus gaya tarik antarmolekul padatan es menjadi cairan, sehingga energi kinetik rata-rata partikel (suhu) tetap $0^\circ\text{C}$.
   - **A** (Miskonsepsi): Mengira pemanas berhenti atau menurunkan dayanya, padahal soal menyatakan daya pemanas konstan.
   - **C** (Miskonsepsi): Menganggap energi hilang seluruhnya ke lingkungan, padahal perubahan wujud dari es ke air memang memerlukan kalor laten.
   - **D** (Miskonsepsi): Mengacaukan konsep kalor jenis (yang berlaku saat suhu berubah) dengan kalor laten perubahan wujud.

2. **Kunci: D**
   - **Alasan benar:** $Q_{\text{II}} = m \cdot L_{\text{es}} = 0{,}2 \times 336.000 = 67.200\text{ J} = 67{,}2\text{ kJ}$, dan $Q_{\text{III}} = m \cdot c_{\text{air}} \cdot \Delta T = 0{,}2 \times 4.200 \times 40 = 33.600\text{ J} = 33{,}6\text{ kJ}$. Total $= 67{,}2 + 33{,}6 = 100{,}8\text{ kJ}$.
   - **A** (Miskonsepsi): Hanya menghitung kalor pemanasan air pada Tahap III ($33{,}6\text{ kJ}$) dan melupakan kalor lebur es pada Tahap II.
   - **B** (Miskonsepsi): Hanya menghitung kalor lebur pada Tahap II ($67{,}2\text{ kJ}$) tanpa menambahkan kalor Tahap III.
   - **C** (Miskonsepsi): Menggunakan nilai $c_{\text{es}} = 2.100$ pada Tahap III ($0{,}2 \times 2.100 \times 40 = 16{,}8\text{ kJ}$), sehingga memperoleh $67{,}2 + 16{,}8 = 84{,}0\text{ kJ}$.

3. **Model Jawaban & Rubrik Penilaian (Total: 10 poin):**
   - **Bagian a `[5 poin]`:**
     - $Q_{\text{I}} = m \cdot c_{\text{es}} \cdot \Delta T = 0{,}2 \times 2.100 \times (0 - (-10)) = 4.200\text{ J} = 4{,}2\text{ kJ}$. `[3 poin]`
     - $Q_{\text{total}} = Q_{\text{I}} + Q_{\text{II}} + Q_{\text{III}} = 4{,}2 + 67{,}2 + 33{,}6 = 105{,}0\text{ kJ}$. `[2 poin]`
   - **Bagian b `[5 poin]`:**
     - Laju Tahap I $= \frac{10^\circ\text{C}}{1\text{ menit}} = 10^\circ\text{C}/\text{menit}$; laju Tahap III $= \frac{40^\circ\text{C}}{8\text{ menit}} = 5^\circ\text{C}/\text{menit}$. `[2 poin]`
     - Penjelasan: karena daya pemanas $P$ dan massa $m$ sama, laju kenaikan suhu $\frac{\Delta T}{\Delta t} = \frac{P}{m c}$ berbanding terbalik dengan kalor jenis $c$. Karena $c_{\text{air}} = 4.200$ bernilai tepat dua kali $c_{\text{es}} = 2.100$, laju kenaikan suhu air menjadi tepat setengah kali laju kenaikan suhu es ($5^\circ\text{C}/\text{menit}$ dibanding $10^\circ\text{C}/\text{menit}$). `[3 poin]`

4. **Model Jawaban & Rubrik Penilaian (Total: 10 poin):**
   - **Bagian a `[6 poin]`:**
     - Perubahan suhu $\Delta T = 120 - 20 = 100^\circ\text{C}$. `[1 poin]`
     - Baja: $\Delta L_{\text{baja}} = L_0 \cdot \alpha_{\text{baja}} \cdot \Delta T = 2 \times 1{,}2 \times 10^{-5} \times 100 = 2{,}4 \times 10^{-3}\text{ m} = 2{,}4\text{ mm}$. `[2,5 poin]`
     - Aluminium: $\Delta L_{\text{Al}} = L_0 \cdot \alpha_{\text{Al}} \cdot \Delta T = 2 \times 2{,}4 \times 10^{-5} \times 100 = 4{,}8 \times 10^{-3}\text{ m} = 4{,}8\text{ mm}$. `[2,5 poin]`
   - **Bagian b `[4 poin]`:**
     - Bimetal akan melengkung **ke arah batang baja** (logam dengan koefisien muai panjang lebih kecil). `[2 poin]`
     - Alasan: saat dipanaskan, aluminium memuai dua kali lebih panjang ($4{,}8\text{ mm}$) dibandingkan baja ($2{,}4\text{ mm}$); karena keduanya dikeling menyatu, sisi aluminium yang lebih panjang membentuk busur luar sedangkan baja berada di sisi dalam lengkungan. `[2 poin]`
<<</ANSWER_KEY>>>

Create an exam package with the following specifications:
- Topic: English: Critical Discourse, Pragmatics, and Workplace Communication Evaluation
- Education Level: SMK
- Cognitive Profile (Bloom): C5-C6
- Question Formats: Mixed
- Number of Questions: 4
- Language: English

Additional Instructions:
Include 2 standard MCQs, 1 Complex MCQ, and 1 Essay grounded in authentic workplace or public communication excerpts.

<<<STUDENT_SHEET>>>
# Vocational High School (SMK) English Exam — Critical Discourse & Workplace Communication

**Instructions:** Questions 1–2 are single-choice MCQs (choose A, B, C, D, or E). Question 3 is a Complex MCQ (select all correct options; full credit requires selecting every correct option and zero incorrect ones). Question 4 is an analytical writing task.

1. A corporate sustainability press release states: *"Under optimal market conditions, our new packaging initiative is projected to reduce plastic waste by up to 35% over the coming decade."* Which critical discourse evaluation accurately identifies the pragmatic function of the italicized hedging devices ("under optimal market conditions," "is projected to," "up to")?
A. They protect the company from binding accountability by framing an optimistic ceiling as a conditional forecast rather than a guaranteed target.
B. They demonstrate complete statistical certainty by establishing a verified 35% minimum floor for annual waste reduction.
C. They signal that independent auditors have already certified the packaging transition across every regional factory.
D. They establish a legally enforceable penalty schedule in the event that plastic output falls below 35%.
E. They obscure the speaker's identity through active-voice imperative verbs aimed directly at retail consumers.

2. Compare two incident notices after a payroll portal outage:
   - Draft X: *"Following a routine server update, unauthorized access to payroll records occurred on Tuesday."*
   - Draft Y: *"During Tuesday's server update, our engineering team misconfigured an access rule, exposing payroll records for 40 minutes."*
   Which discourse shift distinguishes Draft X from Draft Y?
A. Draft X adds technical root-cause precision that enables employees to audit server permissions themselves.
B. Draft X adopts direct personal pronouns to accept immediate operational responsibility for the breach.
C. Draft X conceals human agency through nominalization ("unauthorized access") and an agentless verb ("occurred").
D. Draft X heightens urgency by specifying the exact exposure duration and accountable department.
E. Draft X shifts blame explicitly onto external payroll vendors rather than internal configuration changes.

3. Read the following opinion excerpt on vocational automation:
   *"Modernizing our technical schools means choosing between embracing full robotics immediately or condemning graduates to obsolete, dead-end manual labor. Anyone questioning rapid automation simply clings to outdated nostalgia while ignoring the effortless efficiency promised by autonomous assembly lines."*
   Choose more than one correct critique of the persuasive strategies used in this excerpt (Complex MCQ — full credit requires selecting all true statements and zero false statements):
A. The excerpt relies strictly on longitudinal wage data comparing automated and manual vocational graduates.
B. The first sentence constructs a false dichotomy by eliminating intermediate options such as hybrid human-machine training.
C. The second sentence uses ad hominem framing ("clings to outdated nostalgia") to dismiss policy concerns without addressing them.
D. Loaded adjectives like "dead-end" and "effortless" substitute emotional framing for concrete cost-benefit evidence.
E. The passage acknowledges structural transition challenges such as equipment maintenance costs and instructor retraining.

4. Evaluate and revise the following terse customer-service email sent by an electronics supplier after shipping the wrong voltage adapters:
   *"Due to unexpected client-side order misunderstandings and routine warehouse adjustments, your shipment experienced minor specification discrepancies. Normal procedures were followed, and replacements may be discussed next month."*
   a) Diagnose two specific discourse flaws in this email that undermine customer trust and professional accountability. [6 pts]
   b) Rewrite the email in 3–4 concise sentences using active ownership, transparent corrective action, and a concrete timeline. [9 pts]
<<</STUDENT_SHEET>>>
<<<ANSWER_KEY>>>
1. **Answer: A**
   **Why right:** Epistemic hedges ("projected to," "up to," "under optimal conditions") weaken commitment by turning a best-case ceiling into a conditional prediction rather than a verifiable obligation.
   - B: Misconception reading "up to 35%" as a guaranteed minimum floor rather than a maximum ceiling.
   - C: Misconception inferring third-party audit verification where none is stated.
   - D: Misconception treating non-binding hedging language as a legally enforceable penalty clause.
   - E: Misconception misidentifying passive/hedged declarative syntax as active-voice imperatives.

2. **Answer: C**
   **Why right:** Draft X turns an action into an abstract noun ("unauthorized access") paired with an intransitive verb ("occurred"), erasing who misconfigured the system.
   - A: Misconception attributing greater technical precision to Draft X, whereas Draft Y supplies the actual mechanism and duration.
   - B: Misconception reversing the drafts; Draft Y uses "our engineering team," whereas Draft X omits pronouns.
   - D: Misconception reversing the drafts; Draft Y provides the 40-minute duration and responsible team.
   - E: Misconception claiming external vendor blame, which appears in neither draft.

3. **Answer: B, C, D**
   **Why right:** Framing the issue as either total instant robotics or "dead-end manual labor" creates a false dichotomy (B), dismissing skeptics as clinging to "outdated nostalgia" attacks motives rather than arguments (C), and "dead-end"/"effortless" use loaded diction instead of evidence (D).
   - A: Misconception claiming empirical wage data is present, when no data is cited.
   - E: Misconception reading critical balance into an excerpt that omits transition costs entirely.

4. **Model Solution:**
   a) Two discourse flaws: (1) **Blame-shifting and defensive nominalization**: "client-side order misunderstandings" and "warehouse adjustments" evade responsibility and imply the customer caused the supplier's shipping error; (2) **Vague minimization and indefinite delay**: calling wrong-voltage adapters "minor specification discrepancies" downplays safety/usability risks, while "may be discussed next month" offers no concrete resolution.
   b) **Sample Revision:** "Thank you for alerting us to the incorrect voltage adapters included in your recent shipment—we take full responsibility for this fulfillment error. We have already queued the correct 220V adapters for priority dispatch at no extra charge, and they will arrive within three business days via tracking #TRK-408. Please use the prepaid return label attached to send back the mismatched units at your convenience, or reply directly if your production schedule requires urgent assistance."
   **Point Breakdown [15 pts]:**
   - Part (a): 3 pts per accurately diagnosed discourse flaw backed by text evidence (6 pts total)
   - Part (b): 3 pts active ownership without blame-shifting; 3 pts concrete corrective action & timeline; 3 pts professional, concise tone in 3–4 sentences (9 pts total)
<<</ANSWER_KEY>>>

Buatkan paket soal ujian dengan spesifikasi berikut:
- Topik: Fluida Statis dan Fluida Dinamis
- Jenjang Pendidikan: SMA
- Profil Kognitif (Bloom): C4-C6
- Format Soal: Essay
- Jumlah Soal: 3
- Bahasa: Bahasa Indonesia

Materi Referensi:
Data Praktikum Laboratorium Fluida ($g = 10\text{ m/s}^2$, $\rho_{\text{air}} = 1.000\text{ kg/m}^3$):
1. Percobaan Pipa U (Hukum Pokok Hidrostatika):
   - Kaki kanan berisi air, kaki kiri diisi minyak X yang tidak bercampur dengan air.
   - Tinggi kolom minyak X di atas bidang batas minyak-air adalah $h_X = 20\text{ cm}$.
   - Tinggi kolom air di kaki kanan di atas bidang batas yang sama adalah $h_{\text{air}} = 16\text{ cm}$.
2. Percobaan Venturimeter Horizontal (Mengalirkan Air):
   - Luas penampang pipa utama $A_1 = 20\text{ cm}^2 = 2 \times 10^{-3}\text{ m}^2$ dan luas leher sempit $A_2 = 10\text{ cm}^2 = 1 \times 10^{-3}\text{ m}^2$.
   - Data pengamatan beda tinggi kolom air pada dua pipa vertikal di penampang 1 dan 2 ($\Delta h$) serta debit terukur ($Q_{\text{ukur}}$):
     | Uji | Beda Tinggi $\Delta h$ (cm) | Debit Terukur $Q_{\text{ukur}}$ ($\text{m}^3/\text{s}$) |
     |---|---|---|
     | Uji A | 15 | $1{,}8 \times 10^{-3}$ |
     | Uji B | 60 | $3{,}6 \times 10^{-3}$ |

<<<STUDENT_SHEET>>>
# Ujian Fisika SMA: Fluida Statis dan Fluida Dinamis
**Petunjuk:** Jawablah seluruh soal uraian berikut dengan merujuk langsung pada tabel dan data di Materi Referensi. Tulis persamaan, konversi satuan, dan interpretasi fisis secara lengkap.

1. **[15 poin]** Analisis Percobaan Pipa U dan Gaya Apung:
   a. **[7 poin]** Tentukan massa jenis minyak X ($\rho_X$) dari data ketinggian kolom fluida pada Percobaan 1.
   b. **[8 poin]** Sebuah kubus padat bersisi $10\text{ cm}$ dan bermassa $850\text{ gram}$ dicelupkan ke dalam bejana berisi minyak X murni. Prediksi keadaan benda (mengapung, melayang, atau tenggelam) dan hitung besar gaya normal yang diberikan dasar bejana pada kubus jika menyentuh dasar, atau persentase volume tercelup jika mengapung.

2. **[15 poin]** Analisis Aliran Ideal pada Venturimeter:
   a. **[8 poin]** Menggunakan persamaan kontinuitas dan Bernoulli untuk fluida ideal, hitung kelajuan ideal $v_1$, $v_2$, dan debit ideal $Q_{\text{ideal}}$ pada Uji A ($\Delta h = 15\text{ cm}$) serta Uji B ($\Delta h = 60\text{ cm}$).
   b. **[7 poin]** Hitung beda tekanan hidrostatis $\Delta P = P_1 - P_2$ pada Uji B, dan jelaskan secara kuantitatif mengapa ketika $\Delta h$ dinaikkan $4$ kali lipat (dari $15\text{ cm}$ menjadi $60\text{ cm}$), debit ideal hanya meningkat menjadi $2$ kali lipat.

3. **[20 poin]** Diagnosis Anomali Eksperimen dan Perancangan Ulang:
   a. **[10 poin]** Seorang praktikan berargumen bahwa $Q_{\text{ukur}}$ pada Uji A dan Uji B lebih kecil $10\%$ daripada $Q_{\text{ideal}}$ karena penyempitan pipa menurunkan tekanan sehingga sebagian massa air hilang selama mengalir. Evaluasi kekeliruan hukum kekekalan pada argumen tersebut dan jelaskan penyebab fisis sebenarnya dari $Q_{\text{ukur}} < Q_{\text{ideal}}$.
   b. **[10 poin]** Untuk keperluan instalasi industri menggunakan Venturimeter dengan koefisien debit yang sama ($C_d = Q_{\text{ukur}} / Q_{\text{ideal}} = 0{,}90$), dibutuhkan debit terukur minimal $5{,}4 \times 10^{-3}\text{ m}^3/\text{s}$. Rancang nilai $Q_{\text{ideal}}$ target dan tentukan beda tinggi kolom air $\Delta h$ yang harus dicapai pada alat.
<<</STUDENT_SHEET>>>
<<<ANSWER_KEY>>>
1. **Solusi & Rubrik Soal 1 [Total 15 poin]**
   - **a. Massa Jenis Minyak X [7 poin]:**
     - Tekanan hidrostatis pada bidang batas sama: $\rho_X g h_X = \rho_{\text{air}} g h_{\text{air}}$.
     - $\rho_X (20\text{ cm}) = 1.000(16\text{ cm}) \implies \rho_X = 800\text{ kg/m}^3$.
     - *Pembagian poin:* Persamaan keseimbangan hidrostatika Pipa U (3 poin); perhitungan dan satuan $\rho_X = 800\text{ kg/m}^3$ (4 poin).
   - **b. Prediksi & Gaya pada Kubus [8 poin]:**
     - Volume kubus $V = (0{,}1\text{ m})^3 = 10^{-3}\text{ m}^3$; massa $m = 0{,}85\text{ kg} \implies \rho_{\text{kubus}} = 850\text{ kg/m}^3$.
     - Karena $\rho_{\text{kubus}} = 850\text{ kg/m}^3 > \rho_X = 800\text{ kg/m}^3$, kubus **tenggelam** ke dasar bejana.
     - Berat $w = mg = 0{,}85(10) = 8{,}5\text{ N}$; gaya apung $F_A = \rho_X V g = 800(10^{-3})(10) = 8{,}0\text{ N}$.
     - Gaya normal dasar bejana: $N = w - F_A = 8{,}5 - 8{,}0 = 0{,}5\text{ N}$.
     - *Pembagian poin:* Menghitung $\rho_{\text{kubus}}$ dan prediksi tenggelam (4 poin); menghitung $w, F_A$, dan gaya normal $N = 0{,}5\text{ N}$ (4 poin).

2. **Solusi & Rubrik Soal 2 [Total 15 poin]**
   - **a. Kelajuan & Debit Ideal [8 poin]:**
     - Kontinuitas: $A_1 v_1 = A_2 v_2 \implies 20 v_1 = 10 v_2 \implies v_2 = 2 v_1$.
     - Bernoulli horizontal: $\rho g \Delta h = \frac{1}{2}\rho(v_2^2 - v_1^2) = \frac{3}{2}\rho v_1^2 \implies v_1 = \sqrt{\frac{2 g \Delta h}{3}}$.
     - Uji A ($\Delta h = 0{,}15\text{ m}$): $v_1 = \sqrt{\frac{2(10)(0{,}15)}{3}} = 1\text{ m/s}$, $v_2 = 2\text{ m/s}$, $Q_{\text{ideal}} = (2\times 10^{-3})(1) = 2{,}0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ m}^3/\text{s}$.
     - Uji B ($\Delta h = 0{,}60\text{ m}$): $v_1 = \sqrt{\frac{2(10)(0{,}60)}{3}} = 2\text{ m/s}$, $v_2 = 4\text{ m/s}$, $Q_{\text{ideal}} = (2\times 10^{-3})(2) = 4{,}0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ m}^3/\text{s}$.
     - *Pembagian poin:* Penurunan $v_1 = \sqrt{2g\Delta h/3}$ (3 poin); hasil Uji A (2,5 poin); hasil Uji B (2,5 poin).
